style_name: Prismatic Sanctuary Painterly & Masked Diffraction Foil
style_description: High-contrast painterly fantasy creatures with luminous anatomical focal points (crystalline wings, bioluminescent antlers, void-phase blades, magma runes, oceanic jade currents, celestial astrolabe rings) framed inside obsidian-and-celestial-gold collector cards with masked diffraction shaders, materializing onto a dark slate & crystal sanctuary arena.

camera.view: Interactive 3D-tilted collector card inspection in Collection/Prep; angled 2.5D dimensional tabletop sanctuary perspective in Battle
camera.framing: 6v6 two-row hex formation (3 Frontline, 3 Backline per side) with top Prism Gauge bar, left Card Inspector & Foil Studio, and right Causal Resonance Log
camera.perspective: 32-degree tilted obsidian sanctuary floor with floating holographic projection pedestals and volumetric creature sprites

value_hierarchy: 1. Active Resonance chain beams, Voltbrand electrical marks, Refractive Ward facets, and Convergence waves (highest luminance 85-100%)
2. Creature silhouettes, glowing eyes/wings/core anchors, and card typography/stat badges (70-90%)
3. Masked card foil iridescence and hex pedestal rims (35-65%)
4. Deep obsidian sanctuary floor and dark celestial backdrop (5-18% value — prevents visual noise)
shape_language: Storm: jagged lightning fangs and swept wings; Crystal: faceted geometric antlers and prism shields; Void: asymmetrical scythe-blades and rift tears; Flame: heavy molten plate and rising embers; Verdant: spiraling botanical horns; Tide: sinuous abyssal ribbons; Astral: celestial rings; Eclipse: crescent shadow-halos.
lighting_language: Cool celestial rim lighting on dark obsidian slate punctuated by Origin-coded bioluminescence and angle-dependent spectral foil diffraction.
material_language: Three explicit foil shaders masked away from text plates: (1) Prismatic Spectrum — rainbow micro-hex diffraction on wings/scales; (2) Phantom Foil — dark obsidian chrome with oil-slick violet/cyan sheen; (3) Relic Foil — embossed antique gold/platinum filigree with illuminated runes.
identity_invariants: Creature silhouette must read clearly at both full card scale (320x440) and arena projection scale (120x120).
Foil diffraction is masked to creature highlights and frame filigree — never washed uniformly over text or stat badges.

Every Resonance state has a geometric + color dual indicator: Voltbrand (lightning diamond + cyan arc), Refractive Ward (hexagonal crystal prism + teal barrier), Phase Rend (void crescent + magenta rift), Solar Brand (ember crown + gold flare).
forbidden_traits: Full-card unmasked rainbow gradient washing out typography
Pay-to-win stat changes tied to foil rarity
Unreadable black-crushed creature silhouettes against dark arena floors
Shipped raw third-party reference images in the game build

asset_rules.transparent_sprites: Generated at 1024x1024 on solid dark backdrop via FLUX.2 Klein 4B fp8, edge-background removed, trimmed with 8px padding, and packed into spritesheet + atlas.
asset_rules.environment: 1024x1024 painterly Prismatic Sanctuary arena backdrop generated via FLUX.2 Klein 4B fp8.
asset_rules.ui: Obsidian & brushed gold collector frames with high-contrast tabular numbers and WCAG-compliant stat plates.
asset_rules.vfx: Causal procedural + shader-driven Voltbrand arcs, Refractive Ward facets, Void Phase rifts, and Prism Gauge Convergence waves.
asset_rules.animation: Breathing/idle/attack/resonance frame sequences audited via ags animation audit & assembled via ags animation build.

review_criteria: Each of the 8 creatures is distinguishable by silhouette and Origin color before reading its name.
All 3 foil tiers (Prismatic Spectrum, Phantom Foil, Relic Foil) visibly respond to cursor tilt and light angle.
Resonance chains (Voltbrand -> Refractive Ward -> Phase Rend) are visually unmistakable in live battle and recorded in the causal log.
style_mix_policy: All shipped creature and arena raster assets are generated with FLUX.2 Klein 4B Distilled FP8 under uniform painterly dark-celestial prompts and processed through the deterministic studio alpha/trim pipeline.
